name: GENDA Inc.
summary: GENDA Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the entertainment business in Japan, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, France, Mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia, and Vietnam. The company operates through the Entertainment Platform and Entertainment Content segments. It operates amusement arcades under GIGO brand; nighttime entertainment business under GIGO EDGE; equipment maintenance business under GIGO SOLUTIONS; GENDA, sales and lease amusement machines; and ENTERRIUM LLC develop and operates of entertainment complexes.
